title: Amours De Voyage
author: Arthur Hugh Clough
description: "Amours De Voyage" by Arthur Hugh Clough is a philosophical poem written in the early 20th century, specifically during the Edwardian era.
longDescription: This work is a poetic exploration of travel, love, and the contrasts between idealism and realism in human experience.

authorInfo.bio: Arthur Hugh Clough (1819–1861) wrote Amours De Voyage. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
